messages:
jen: Heads-up: preparing release notes for v2.3.0 — runtime kernel selection + batching. Target window Mon 2026-03-22 00:00-02:00 PST. Who can draft internal announcement and pin? Need rollback criteria and deploybot cadence.

alex-pm: I can do a short internal blurb. Keep it to two bullets (what, impact) + RN link. Who owns rollback thresholds?

rachel-docs: I’ll draft RN and pin. Will include a one-line upgrade note and links to runbooks.

nate: I’ll own thresholds & canary lanes. Proposed abort conditions: 5xx > 0.5% for 5m in canary OR p95 latency >40% above baseline for 10m. Also suggest auto-rollback on error-budget burn >60% for 15m.

sam-oncall: +1. I’m on standby. Add an explicit escalation path to eng-sre in the RN.

ops-lead: Rollout cadence: staging -> canary (5% for 30m) -> ramp 50% for 30m -> full. deploy-bot will orchestrate. If canary aborts, bot pauses and notifies oncall.

deploy-bot: [system] Pipeline scheduled: release=v2.3.0 lanes=[staging,canary,global] canary=5% canary_duration=30m ramp_to=50% after 30m owner=@nate

jen: Rachel, add pinning policy line: pin services to model@v2.3.0, fallback to model@v2.2.x if rolled back or capacity constrained.

rachel-docs: Draft ready — short blurb below. Adding links to deploybot playbook and rollback checklist.

rachel-docs: "Heads-up: v2.3.0 rolling Mon 03/22 00:00-02:00 PST. Changes: runtime kernel selection improvements + batching optimizations. User impact: none expected. Rollout: staging -> 5% canary (30m) -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback: 5xx >0.5% (5m), p95 >40% (10m), error-budget >60% (15m). Owner: @nate. Pinning: model@v2.3.0 with fallback to model@v2.2.x. Oncall: @sam-oncall. Docs: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.0 | deploybot runbook | rollback checklist"

alex-pm: LGTM. I’ll prepare a single-line for #general after RN is pinned.

jen: Final checklist: RN link updated, pinning line included, deploybot triggers committed, oncall confirmed, ops brief pinned. Rachel to pin in ~10m.

sam-oncall: Standby confirmed. Pager rotation verified.

nate: Added triggers to deploy-bot config. Snippet: deploybot set-trigger --release v2.3.0 --canary 5 --canary-duration 30m --abort-on 5xx>0.5%:5m,latency_p95>40%:10m,error_budget>60%:15m

deploy-bot: [system] Triggers saved. Next action: start pipeline at 2026-03-22T00:00:00-08:00

jen: Thanks all. Update thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
